questions.text: If the estimate the total discounted benefits for a project is birr 120,000 and total discounted cost is birr 100,000 what is the estimated return on investment (ROI) percentage?

options.explanation: Correct. 20% — this directly answers the question. In Project Management, this is the standard/principle being tested.
Incorrect. 12% — ROI = (Benefits − Cost) / Cost × 100 = (120000−100000)/100000 = 20%. The correct choice is A.
Incorrect. 30% — ROI = (Benefits − Cost) / Cost × 100 = (120000−100000)/100000 = 20%. The correct choice is A.
Incorrect. 10% — ROI = (Benefits − Cost) / Cost × 100 = (120000−100000)/100000 = 20%. The correct choice is A.

questions.concept: Key idea (Project Management): 20%
